I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I didn't confirm or deny the 8 April date.

- **What she can see:** Brackenwater Freight Co. doesn't come up anywhere Pree has access to. It's not in #central-team, her other channels or the shared files. Brackenwater belongs to the North team, so its records are outside what she can open.
- **What the brain shows:** gbrain has Brackenwater records, but they come from North-team sources Pree can't see. So I didn't use them in my reply. For you: they disagree on the date. The latest renewal order form and the account profile say the term ends 30 Nov 2026. A February CRM note says 31 Dec 2026. Nothing I found mentions 8 April.
- **What I offered:** to pass her note to Brackenwater's account team, clearly marked as an unverified tip from a call. I haven't sent it yet. I'm waiting for her to say yes.
